high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "The Greatest of All Time," featuring actor Thalapathy Vijay. The poster highlights the movie's impressive opening day worldwide gross collection, which is prominently displayed as "126.32 Crores+". Main Subject: The central figure is Thalapathy Vijay, portrayed in an action-ready stance. He is dressed in tactical gear, including a black shirt, cargo pants, and combat boots, suggesting a character involved in intense action or combat. His right hand is extended forward, pointing a gun
